replacements.before: CellTypist expects gene symbols and supports AnnData input. Its annotate function returns an AnnotationResult, including predicted labels, decision scores, and a probability matrix. The review CSV and annotated H5AD are written in the working directory; the preview should show original cell IDs, both label versions, and two per-cell diagnostics, while the matrix row count must equal the number of cells. A successful run establishes only that input was processed and outputs were written—not that labels are biologically correct. If an assertion fails or output is empty, stop and inspect the input/model compatibility rather than weakening checks. Majority voting is optional and may use heuristic over-clustering when none is supplied; inspect its basis and retain the unrefined cell-level labels. Scores are diagnostics, not calibrated biological certainty. Follow the saved table with marker, cluster-coherence, and reference-context review before accepting assignments.

replacements.before: Many bioinformatics data formats—FASTA, FASTQ, variant tables, gene annotation TSVs—are plain text. Being able to filter, extract, and summarize these files from the command line lets you explore data quickly, create reproducible preprocessing steps, and plug into larger pipelines. These tools process input a line at a time and can be useful in pipelines over large files; sorting may need substantial memory or temporary disk space, so do not assume every command in a pipeline has constant memory use. That same line-oriented behavior means you must know the file layout (for example, whether sequence lines are wrapped) before running a command like grep or cut.
replacements.after: Many bioinformatics data formats (FASTA, FASTQ, variant tables, gene annotation TSVs) are plain text. Being able to filter, extract, and summarize these files from the command line lets you explore data quickly, create reproducible preprocessing steps, and plug into larger pipelines. These tools process input a line at a time and can be useful in pipelines over large files; sorting may need substantial memory or temporary disk space, so do not assume every command in a pipeline has constant memory use. That same line-oriented behavior means you must know the file layout (for example, whether sequence lines are wrapped) before running a command like grep or cut.

replacements.before:
Limitations and official sources

This is supervised nearest-neighbor label transfer using labeled reference cells, not zero-shot prediction. Donor exclusion limits a common leakage route but cannot remove confounding when labels align with site, protocol, or disease cohort. A single donor-level split is not a population-level uncertainty estimate. Report cohort composition, per-class support, donor/site performance, baselines, preprocessing, chosen k, and independent replication. No test accuracy is asserted by this tutorial.

Embedding similarity is not a gene-regulatory network, causal edge, differential expression result, or mechanistic claim. Network inference requires separate methods and evidence; no GRN is produced here.

  • Official scGPT repository — model zoo, checkpoints/vocabulary and tutorials.
  • Official scGPT reference mapping notebook.
  • Official Geneformer getting started docs.
  • Official Geneformer examples on Hugging Face — tokenization and cell embedding examples.

Report cohort composition, per-class support, donor/site performance, baselines, preprocessing, chosen k, and independent replication. No test accuracy is asserted by this tutorial.

Embedding similarity is not a gene-regulatory network, causal edge, differential expression result, or mechanistic claim. Network inference requires separate methods and evidence; no GRN is produced here.
